svg.aria-label: Diagram of the Lyx platform I work on: external sources feed a NestJS modular monolith and a Python ETL; both land in Postgres and are read by Next.js fronts and BI; every change goes through a delivery loop of pull request, CI audit gate, AI review agent, deploy train and production.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
